title: Mathership Birthday — CG02 English Original and Life-Cycle Lexical Forensics

semantic_corrections_from_russian_transl.finding: English explicitly encodes a reborn state and purification imagery; Russian rendering as an imperative loses part of that grammatical distinction

semantic_corrections_from_russian_transl.english: Father to me? Father to all!
semantic_corrections_from_russian_transl.finding: The text expands the father from personal parent to universal paternal authority
The original is surveillance/oversight language, not simply keeper-of-life wording

semantic_corrections_from_russian_transl.english: Harshness of discipline. Harshness of love
semantic_corrections_from_russian_transl.finding: Discipline and love are explicitly parallel forms of harshness
The original uses honeycomb rather than the generic Russian 'sotsy' framing; the hive metaphor is architectural and social
The numeric relationship is spatial/containment language, not merely a statement that 10 has significance
The original explicitly names incineration; the Russian rendering substantially softens the physical image
